name: shoot.order
description: The shooting order from a drag: ids the shoot does not hold are ignored, and ids the order leaves out keep their place at the end.
sql:
update brandbase.shoots s set idea_ids =
    array(select i from jsonb_array_elements_text(:ideaIds::jsonb) with ordinality t(i, n) where i = any (s.idea_ids) group by i order by min(n))
    || array(select i from unnest(s.idea_ids) with ordinality u(i, n) where not (:ideaIds::jsonb ? i) order by n),
  version = s.version + 1, updated_at = now()
where s.id = :id and s.brand_id = :brand
returning brandbase.shoot_json(s) as result
